from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(grid):
    # A vertical marker separates two equal-width binary pictures.
    sep = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and grid[0][c] not in (0,))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
# Separator may be uniform color nonzero, but test itself has col5 8; demo col14 6.
p=program_dir/'task-f655b4df.py'; p.write_text(prog)
print(p.read_text())
